subject: SIG Access Artifacts & SAML Assertion Samples — evidence drop request
messages:
From: Amy Chung <amy.chung@sigassessor.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: SIG Assessment Team <sig@sigassessor.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: Access artifacts & SAML assertion samples request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for agreeing to support HelioLabs' SIG assessment. We've started the access control review and need a handful of artifacts to complete the SSO/SCIM/RBAC sections. Would you be able to provide the following by EOD Wednesday (three business days)? If that's not feasible, please suggest a date.

Requested artifacts (preferred as redacted ZIPs or secure upload links):
- One or two SAML assertion samples for a standard user login and a privileged user login (include timestamps)
- SCIM delta export covering 2026-08-01 -> 2026-09-10 (user create/update/delete events)
- RBAC role matrix export and a mapping of roles -> permissions (CSV or spreadsheet)
- Snapshot of current privileged accounts and justifications (redacted emails OK)
- Any automation scripts or templates used for provisioning (high level)
- Short statement confirming least-privilege controls and how role changes are approved

I've attached the SIG_questionnaire_v2.pdf with the exact references. For secure delivery, we can accept a temporary secure link (e.g., ShareFile / OneDrive Share) or an SFTP drop; share the link and any passphrase. If you have an artifact manifest file, that helps our intake team.

Let me know if we should break this into two deliveries (e.g., assertions + RBAC first, SCIM later).

Best,
Amy Chung
Senior Assessor — SIG Support
Security Assessments, Inc.
Attachment: SIG_questionnaire_v2.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood-inference.com>
To: Amy Chung <amy.chung@sigassessor.com>

Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Access artifacts & SAML assertion samples request

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Amy Chung <amy.chung@sigassessor.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Access artifacts & SAML assertion samples request

Adding technical details so Amy's team knows what to expect on delivery.

Planned deliverables (package 1):
- SAML assertions: two XML samples in XML file form. One for svc-audit@redwood-inference.com (privileged) and one for jane.doe@helio.com (standard). Each will include a timestamp, subjectFormat, NameID, and the saml:Attribute for groups.
- RBAC export: CSV from our internal permissions service (columns: role, permission, resource_pattern). Will also include a brief mapping doc (roles_to_permissions.md).
- Privileged accounts snapshot: CSV with account identifier, title, reason for privilege, last_approval_date (we will redact email addresses with internal IDs, e.g., acct-8472).
- Short control statement (1 page) describing least-privilege workflow and role change approvals (who signs off).

SCIM delta (package 2): we can emit a CSV with delta rows for the requested date window; note that deletions are stored as tombstone records and will be included. Our SCIM service supports export via an internal tool; estimated extraction time ~ 2 hours — we'll schedule for Monday morning to avoid interfering with peak ops.

Attachments to expect: artifact_delivery_plan.md (high level steps & timeline).

Jonas
Engineering Lead, Identity & Access
Redwood Inference
Attachment: artifact_delivery_plan.md
From: Amy Chung <amy.chung@sigassessor.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Access artifacts & SAML assertion samples request

Thanks — this looks good and matches what our intake team needs. We've created a secure drop for HelioLabs: https://secure-share.heliofiles.com/s/Helio-Redwood-SIG-drop-9f3a (expires 2026-09-22). Please upload package (1) to that link and set the file description to the artifact manifest name. For encryption in transit, the drop uses TLS and we recommend adding a short passphrase in a separate email.

On redactions: the assessor team can work with internal IDs; please exclude full user emails for non-consented customers. For any items that require an NDA before delivery (if any of the provisioning templates include customer-identifying configs), we'll flag them — but based on your plan it should be fine.

If you run into any problems with the upload, reply here and we'll provide an alternate SFTP. Once files are in, intake will confirm within 24 hours and assign review owners.

Best,
Amy
Attachment: upload_instructions.txt
